chats.answer:
The best HDMI extender cable depends on how far you need to extend your connection and whether you're using 4K, 8K, or a high-refresh-rate gaming monitor.

For most people, I'd recommend a UGREEN or Cable Matters HDMI extension cable. If you're using 4K at 120Hz or 8K, look for an Ultra High Speed HDMI extension rated for 48 Gbps.

One important distinction: an HDMI extension cable has a male connector on one end and a female connector on the other. An HDMI extender over Ethernet is a different product designed for much longer distances.

chats.answer:
The best HDMI extender depends on how far you need to extend the connection and whether you're using it for a 4K TV, gaming monitor, projector, or computer.

For most people, I recommend an HDMI 2.1 extension cable (male-to-female) that supports 48 Gbps, 4K at 120 Hz, and 8K at 60 Hz.

One important distinction:

3–6 ft extension: A passive HDMI 2.1 extension cable is usually sufficient.

10–15 ft extension: Look for a certified, high-quality cable and pay attention to the total cable length.

25–100+ ft: An active optical HDMI cable or HDMI-over-Cat6 extender is usually a better solution.
